findings.title: `queued` is evaluated once at module import rather than per assignment source
findings.body: `timezone.now()` is called while the dataclass is defined, so every `AssignmentSource` created by this worker process receives the same `queued` timestamp. Consequently `to_dict()` emits a startup-time value rather than the time the webhook assignment was queued, making the context metadata incorrect and unusable for ordering, expiration, or debugging. Use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)` so each instance gets its own timestamp.
